outputs.text: The filter row sits immediately below the existing status tabs, making file-name, classification, and accounting-month refinement discoverable without creating a competing workflow. criteriaResults.note: Actual PNG reinspection confirms the requested file-name search, classification, month and Clear filters row beneath status tabs.

Labels, controls, document rows and amounts are legible at 1536x1024. Card spacing and navy action hierarchy remain coherent. The raw ICU literal in Pending corrections is inherited baseline debt outside this bounded change.

The output depicts native inputs, selects, buttons and document data. It remains a design direction; interactivity, accessibility and backend behavior require implementation and separate verification.

The scenario execution report records real built-in ImageGen calls. The retained exact prompt and generation context bind this actual PNG and supplied baseline; hashes verify these bytes, not provider identity independently.

Comparison with the supplied baseline confirms white cards, thin gray borders, navy actions, desktop two-column structure and unrelated accounting panels. The request-selected baseline remains authoritative.
